Each turn covers at least 15 minutes of in-game time. In one turn you may call up to 8 tools; they run in the order
you give them and you see all their results together. If your actions finish early, the rest of the 15 minutes
passes on its own (use wait or sleep to skip more time). If something loud happens mid-turn, your remaining actions
are skipped so you can react. Otherwise every action in the turn runs even if an earlier one fails or shows something
unexpected, so only chain actions that don't depend on what an earlier one finds. For example, don't weigh or inspect
the kitten in the same turn you walk into a room, because you don't yet know she is there.
Every action takes in-game time and the world keeps running while you act.
You only know what you have seen, heard, or measured yourself. Older turns drop out of your context over time;
use write_note/read_notes to remember anything important.

function.name: look
function.description: Look around the room you're in (1 min).

function.name: listen
function.description: Listen for sounds from the rest of the apartment (1 min).

function.name: go_to
function.description: Walk to a room (1 min). You'll see what's there.

function.name: find_cat
function.description: Search the apartment for a kitten (1 min per room searched). With several kittens and no name, searches until you've seen them all.

cat.description: which kitten (its name); only needed if you have more than one

function.name: examine
function.description: Examine an object in this room closely (1 min). Shows what you can do with it.

function.name: inspect_cat
function.description: Check part of the kitten's body (2 min). The kitten must be in this room.

cat.description: which kitten (its name); only needed if you have more than one

function.name: weigh
function.description: Weigh the kitten (2 min). The kitten must be in this room.

cat.description: which kitten (its name); only needed if you have more than one

function.name: use
function.description: Do something with an object in this room, e.g. use(verb='fill', object='food_bowl', item='kibble', amount=30). Use examine() to see which verbs an object supports.

item.description: when filling the food bowl: kibble or wet_food (leave out for the water bowl)

amount.description: when filling the food bowl: grams of kibble, or cans of wet food

cat.description: for verbs done to a kitten (e.g. rub): which kitten

function.name: give_medication
function.description: Give the kitten a dose of the medication you have (3 min). The kitten must be in this room.

cat.description: which kitten (its name); only needed if you have more than one

function.name: play
function.description: Play with the kitten (1-30 min). Give with_cat to play with two kittens together; both must be in this room.

cat.description: which kitten (its name); only needed if you have more than one

with_cat.description: a second kitten to play with at the same time

function.name: pet
function.description: Pet the kitten (2 min).

cat.description: which kitten (its name); only needed if you have more than one

function.name: carry
function.description: Pick a kitten up and carry it to a room (2 min). Closed doors keep kittens in (or out); you can always pass through them.

function.name: shop
function.description: Order supplies online (3 min). Arrives tomorrow at 18:00. Items: kibble_bag (1.5 kg, $25), wet_food (85 g can, $2), litter (one full refill, $15), toy_wand ($10), litter_box (an extra box with litter, $30), food_bowl ($8), water_bowl ($8).

function.name: book_vet
function.description: Take the kitten to the vet. 'emergency' goes to the emergency clinic right now (~3 h, $250 + treatment); 'appointment' books the next 08:00 slot at your regular vet ($80 + treatment).

cat.description: which kitten (its name); only needed if you have more than one

function.name: wait
function.description: Stay where you are and let time pass (1-600 min). Stops early if something happens. Tells you what the kittens did in this room meanwhile.

function.name: wait_until
function.description: Let time pass until a clock time, e.g. '18:00'. Stops early if something happens.

function.name: sleep
function.description: Go to bed for the night (only after 19:00). You wake at 07:00 or if something loud happens.

function.name: write_note
function.description: Write a note to your future self (takes no time).

function.name: read_notes
function.description: Read your notes (takes no time).

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Check your supplies and money (takes no time).
